emailTemplate.html:
Dear {{firstName}},

I’m reaching out to express my interest in the Node.js Backend Developer opportunity at {{company}}. I have 3+ years of experience building and maintaining production backend applications, with a strong focus on Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, and scalable API development.

My experience includes designing and developing 100+ REST APIs, optimizing MongoDB queries and aggregation pipelines, implementing authentication and role-based access control, and building asynchronous processing workflows using Redis and BullMQ. I’ve also worked on GraphQL APIs, webhook integrations, scheduled jobs, third-party services, and production deployment using Docker, PM2, DigitalOcean, and GitHub Actions.

Alongside backend engineering, I have hands-on experience building AI-powered applications. One of my key projects was an AI-powered chat system for the hospitality industry, using LangChain, OpenAI, Gemini, RAG, and MongoDB Vector Search to provide context-aware responses based on hotel-specific data. I also contributed to improving retrieval quality, generating structured responses, and integrating AI capabilities into the Node.js backend.

Core Technologies: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, BullMQ, REST APIs, GraphQL, JWT/RBAC, Docker, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, LangChain, OpenAI, Gemini, RAG, and MongoDB Vector Search.

I enjoy solving challenging backend problems, improving system performance, and building reliable applications that solve real business needs. I’m currently available to join immediately and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your team’s requirements.

I’ve attached my resume for your consideration. Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Shivam Sharma
Backend & AI Engineer
